messages.content: What is the dominant genetic trait of a Lion?

function.name: genetics_get_variant_frequency
function.description: Retrieve the frequency of a gene variant in a specific population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content: In lions, the most conspicuous dominant genetic trait is the **normal tawny coat color**. This phenotype is produced by the dominant allele at the MC1R locus (the melanocortin‑1 receptor gene), which drives the production of pheomelanin and gives the typical sandy‑brown fur seen in wild lions. The recessive allele at this locus produces the rare white‑lion phenotype, so the presence of the dominant allele ensures the standard tawny coloration.
